nodes.description: Private address state variable storing the vesting beneficiary who receives released tokens.
Constant-like uint state variable representing one month in seconds (2629743) used to derive cliff and release durations.
Cliff duration in seconds computed at declaration as _month * 6.
Release/vesting duration in seconds computed at declaration as _month * 5.
Absolute UNIX timestamp when the cliff ends; computed in the constructor as start + _cliffDuration.
Absolute UNIX timestamp when vesting starts, provided as a constructor argument.
IERC20 token being vested; also the address key used in the _released mapping.
Timestamp of the last successful release, initialized to _cliff and updated in release().
Mapping tracking the amount already released per token address.
Constructor that validates the beneficiary, validates the total duration, validates the final time versus block.timestamp, and initializes _token, _beneficiary, _cliff, _start and _lastRelease.
Public view returning the configured beneficiary address.
Public view returning the cliff timestamp.
Public view returning the vesting start timestamp.
Public view returning the total vesting duration as _cliff + _releaseDuration.
Public view returning the amount already released for the vested token.
Public, unpermissioned function that computes the releasable amount, accumulates it in _released, updates _lastRelease, and transfers tokens to the beneficiary via safeTransfer.
Private view computing the amount that has vested but not yet been released, gated on block.timestamp - _lastRelease >= _month.
Private view computing the total vested amount using block.timestamp, the cliff, the start and the release duration.
Miner/validator-controlled block timestamp used for the cliff check, the monthly release gate, the last-release bookkeeping and the proportional vesting calculation.
External call _token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, unreleased) that transfers tokens to the beneficiary and hands control to an external contract.

require(block.timestamp < _cliff, "Still-in-cliff") in release() — an inverted timestamp guard that blocks release once the cliff has passed, making the function effectively unusable and creating a timestamp-dependency defect.
Unchecked-looking proportional vesting arithmetic totalBalance.mul(block.timestamp.sub(_cliff)).div(_releaseDuration) in _vestedAmount.
Subtraction _vestedAmount().sub(_released[address(_token)]) in _releasableAmount that computes the pending amount.
Arithmetic _cliffDuration + _releaseDuration and start.add(...) performed in the constructor to derive _cliff and validate final time.
Constructor parameter holding the ERC20 token address to be vested.
Constructor parameter holding the beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Constructor parameter holding the vesting start timestamp.
Local variable in release() holding the amount returned by _releasableAmount() that is written to _released and transferred out.
Local variable in _vestedAmount holding _token.balanceOf(address(this)).
Local variable in _vestedAmount holding currentBalance plus the already released amount, used as the vesting base.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token is assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter start is assigned to the _start state variable.
Constructor parameter start flows into the derived _cliff timestamp.
_month is multiplied by 6 to derive the cliff duration.
_month is multiplied by 5 to derive the release duration.
_cliffDuration participates in the constructor duration arithmetic and final-time check.
_releaseDuration participates in the constructor duration arithmetic and final-time check.
block.timestamp feeds the inverted cliff require in release(), making release behavior dependent on miner-controlled time.
block.timestamp is compared against _lastRelease plus a month to decide whether any amount is releasable.
block.timestamp is compared to the cliff and start to determine the vested amount.
_lastRelease is subtracted from block.timestamp in the monthly release gate.
_released is subtracted from _vestedAmount to compute the pending amount.
_token is used to query balanceOf(address(this)) in _vestedAmount.
_releaseDuration is the divisor in the proportional vesting computation.
_cliff is subtracted from block.timestamp in the proportional vesting computation.
block.timestamp enters the mul/div vesting computation.
_start plus the durations defines the full-vesting branch condition in _vestedAmount.
_cliff is compared against block.timestamp to short-circuit vesting to zero before the cliff.
_released is added to the current balance to compute the total vesting base.
The unreleased local amount is added into the _released mapping before the transfer.
The unreleased amount is passed as the value of the external safeTransfer call.
The beneficiary address is the recipient argument of the external safeTransfer call.
The vested token is the target contract of the external safeTransfer call, transferring control to external code.
block.timestamp is written into _lastRelease, so release bookkeeping depends on miner-controlled time.
The value returned by _releasableAmount is stored in the unreleased local variable.
release() calls _releasableAmount() to obtain the amount due.
_releasableAmount() calls _vestedAmount() to compute the vested total.
_vestedAmount() executes the mul/div proportional vesting computation.
_releasableAmount() executes the subtraction of already released amounts.
The constructor executes the duration and start arithmetic including the block.timestamp comparison.
The external safeTransfer call can hand control back into release() (or the token callback) before the transaction completes.

normalization_plan.reason: The token address parameter is only bound to the _token state variable inside the constructor and has no standalone behavior.
The beneficiary parameter is only validated and stored in the constructor before being read by release().
The start timestamp parameter is only used to derive _start and _cliff inside the constructor.
The unreleased local is a temporary result of _releasableAmount that is immediately accumulated and transferred out of release().
currentBalance is a temporary holder of the token balance used only inside _vestedAmount.
totalBalance is a temporary vesting base used only inside the _vestedAmount arithmetic.
